'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***[[European Union]] [[List of ambassadors of the European Union|ambassador]] [[Aidan O'Hara]] is assaulted at his home in [[Khartoum]]. [[High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy|EU Foreign Affairs High Representative]] [[Josep Borrell]] calls the assault a "gross violation of the [[Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations|Vienna Convention]]". [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-65306695 (BBC News)]
**[[Sudan]] closes its airspace, cancelling all flights in and out of the country. [[Kenya]] likewise suspends all flights to and from Sudan. [https://www.flightglobal.com/air-transport/sudanese-airspace-closed-as-armed-conflict-erupts/152865.article (Flight Global)] [https://www.kenyans.co.ke/news/88216-kenya-airways-adjusts-flight-schedules-over-khartoum-fighting (Kenyans.co.ke)]
**[[China]], [[Malaysia]], and the [[United States]] urge their citizens in Sudan to hide, find shelter, or evacuate the country.  [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3217317/chinese-embassy-sudan-issues-high-alert-notice-tells-citizens-stay-indoors-away-windows (SCMP)] [https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/nation/2023/04/17/foreign-ministry-looks-for-ways-to-get-malaysians-out-of-sudan/ (FMT)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/sudan-military-factions-at-war-civilians-cower-death-toll-tops-100/ (CBS News)]
**''De facto'' leader [[Abdel Fattah al-Burhan]] declares the [[Rapid Support Forces]] to be a rebel group, and orders the group dissolved. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/4/17/sudan-army-declares-rsf-a-rebel-group-orders-dissolution (Al Jazeera)] 
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***[[Slovakia]] transfers 13 [[Mikoyan MiG-29|MiG-29 fighter jets]] to [[Ukraine]], according to the [[Ministry of Defence (Slovakia)|Slovak Defence Ministry]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/slovakia-hands-over-all-13-promised-mig-fighter-jets-ukraine-2023-04-17/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Recycling in Australia]]
**Further sites of illicit soft plastic storage are found in [[Sydney]] after the collapse of commercial plastic recycler REDcycle. After taking $20 million from [[Coles_Supermarkets|Coles]] and [[Woolworths (Australia)|Woolworths]] to recycle soft plastics at 2,000 locations, the company instead stored 12,000 tonnes of plastics at more than 44 locations across [[Australia]]. [https://www.9news.com.au/national/supermarket-news-woolworths-plastic-shopping-bag-pile-discovered-from-failed-recycling-scheme/74e29291-4ee2-4948-b716-e5085f8a9167 (9 News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2023/apr/10/more-stockpiles-of-soft-plastics-from-failed-redcycle-recycling-scheme-uncovered (''The Guardian'')]
*The provincial health ministry of [[Santa Fe Province, Argentina|Santa Fe]], [[Argentina]], asks the public to "not underestimate" the current situation of [[dengue fever]] after the province surpasses 10,000 cases and reports its third death from the disease amid a national outbreak. [https://www.lacapital.com.ar/la-ciudad/ante-el-tercer-caso-fatal-dengue-santa-fe-salud-pide-no-subestimar-los-sintomas-n10058597.html (''La Capital'')] [https://www.infobae.com/salud/2023/04/17/confirmaron-dos-muertes-por-dengue-en-caba-y-suman-35-las-victimas-fatales-en-todo-el-pais/ (''Infobae'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Slovakia–Ukraine relations]]
**[[Slovakia]] bans the import of food from [[Ukraine]], following similar decisions made by [[Poland]] and [[Hungary]] last week. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/apr/17/slovakia-joins-poland-hungary-halting-ukraine-grain-imports (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Myanmar]]'s junta leader [[Min Aung Hlaing]] pardons 3,015 prisoners on the occasion of the [[Buddhist New Year]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20230417-myanmar-junta-pardons-3-000-prisoners-to-mark-buddhist-new-year (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Russia|Russian]] opposition politician [[Vladimir Kara-Murza]] is convicted in a [[Moscow]] court on charges of [[treason]] and violating [[Russian_2022_war_censorship_laws|Russia's war censorship laws]], and sentenced to 25 years in prison. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-kara-murza-sentence-b9d389feeb468ca3d19171d0440faa7d#:~:text=A%20Russian%20court%20on%20Monday,on%20critics%20of%20the%20invasion. (AP)]
*The [[Evide data breach]] is made public. [[Ransomware]] results in data being stolen from a company in [[Northern Ireland]] which provides computer services to charities, including a charity that supports adult survivors of child abuse. [https://www.thejournal.ie/investigation-cyber-attack-ireland-charities-6045882-Apr2023/ (''The Journal'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 FIFA U-20 World Cup]]
**[[Argentina]] is confirmed as the host of the [[FIFA U-20 World Cup]] by [[FIFA]], following the suspension of the tournament in [[Indonesia]], which refused to host the [[Israel national under-19 football team|Israeli team]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/argentina-replace-indonesia-under-20-world-cup-host-fifa-2023-04-17 (Reuters)]
*[[2023 World Snooker Championship]]
**A [[World Snooker Championship]] match between [[Robert Milkins]] and [[Joe Perry (snooker player)|Joe Perry]] is abandoned, while another match between [[Mark Allen (snooker player)|Mark Allen]] and [[Fan Zhengyi]] is delayed after [[Just Stop Oil]] activists storm [[Crucible Theatre|The Crucible]] in [[Sheffield]]. Two people are later arrested by [[South Yorkshire Police]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/snooker/65305903 (BBC Sport)]
